description: Use this when the user wants a working web (or mobile) app built for them — e.g. a booking site, a CRM, an internal tool. Generates the full app (screens, API and database) in their Xenition workspace. Takes a few minutes: returns the app's id right away; check progress with app_status, then publish it with deploy_app. The user can also open the link to watch it build. To only open the builder with an idea, use create_app.

idea.description: what the app should do, in the user's words — e.g. 'a booking app for my yoga studio with classes, a timetable and member sign-up'

mobile.description: also generate a native mobile app (takes longer)

name.description: optional app name; the builder picks one from the idea otherwise

name: build_app
title: Build an app
